body: @Haroenv I have another interesting finding. The issue also happens in `stateResults` provided by `connectStateResults` but only if `connectStateResults` is *after* the hits. See here on the following screenshots, `connectStateResults` does not provide the same values when before/after the hits: I remember there was an issue depending on the order of the components [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/5255) as well. Maybe this will give you a lead?
